date_note: El Mostrador (22 November) reports the attack as ongoing and gives no start day; the article's publication day is used. An earlier El Mostrador report is linked in the article but was not read.
exec: A government platform for consular procedures is reportedly still affected by an intrusion, according to anonymous sources.
geo_basis: Chile's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Santiago, as named in the source
impact: According to El Mostrador, the attack on the Consular Attention System has not been contained after more than three weeks; the article gives no count of affected people or records.
plain: El Mostrador reports that a cyberattack on the online consular procedures system of Chile's foreign ministry has not been contained after more than three weeks. The ministry did not respond to its latest questions.
summary: El Mostrador reports that the Consular Attention System of Chile's Foreign Ministry was hit by a cyberattack that, according to its sources, has not been contained after more than three weeks. The article says the national cybersecurity agency ANCI has opened an investigation and that Navy intelligence (DIRINTA) visited to offer support. The ministry did not respond to the outlet's latest questions.
title: Chile's foreign ministry consular system reportedly still compromised after more than three weeks, El Mostrador says

validation.note: Single publisher read (El Mostrador), relying largely on anonymous sources; no ministry or ANCI statement was read. No actor is named.

review.note: Compared title, date, developing status, more than three weeks not contained, phishing, ANCI, DIRINTA, ministry non-response against El Mostrador
